plugins.prepareCmd: dotnet restore Hexalith.Conversations.slnx -p:Version=${nextRelease.version} -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false && dotnet build Hexalith.Conversations.slnx --configuration Release --no-restore -warnaserror -p:Version=${nextRelease.version} -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false && python3 scripts/pack-release-packages.py ./nupkgs ${nextRelease.version} && python3 scripts/validate-nuget-packages.py ./nupkgs ${nextRelease.version} && python3 scripts/validate-consumer-package-references.py ./nupkgs && bash scripts/validate-publication-preflight.sh ${nextRelease.version} verify >&2
plugins.publishCmd: bash scripts/validate-release-secrets.sh && bash scripts/validate-publication-preflight.sh ${nextRelease.version} publish >&2 && dotnet nuget push "./nupkgs/*.nupkg" --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --api-key "$NUGET_API_KEY"
